title: C2S API is JMAP Chat (E2EE mode)
description: Client<->provider API is Mark's JMAP Chat (~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 CORE, -wss-00, later -push-00) in its E2EE deployment mode with bodyType application/mimi-content; provider stores opaque ciphertext. v1 subset: Session, Chat, Message, WSS; PUSH later; Space out of v1 (no MIMI analogue). In MIMI rooms, MIMI room state (MLS GroupContext) is source of truth; JMAP Chat object is a read-only provider-derived projection. Rejected: bespoke HTTPS+JSON API (competes with Mark's own draft; would re-invent sync/push). Rationale: ~/PROJECT/agora/notes/mimi-vs-jmap-chat.md.
